items.title: Apple shares ‘shocking evidence’ against former employee accused of stealing company data for OpenAI
items.summary: Apple says it has evidence that a former employee destroyed evidence of data theft after learning he was under investigation.
items.author: Amanda Silberling

items.title: The Pentagon now has its own version of ChatGPT and Grok
items.summary: Versions of OpenAI's ChatGPT and SpaceXAI's Grok will join Google's Gemini on the Pentagon's central portal for AI tools.
items.author: Kirsten Korosec

items.title: Instagram puts new limits on undisclosed AI profiles
items.summary: As frustration over AI influencers has been growing, Instagram is limiting the reach of undisclosed AI profiles.
items.author: Lauren Forristal

items.title: Harvard Law dropout raises $6M for Blue Voice to build a ‘Harvey for police officers’
items.summary: Blue Voice is trained on department-specific laws, local ordinances, protocols, and guidelines that general-purpose AI tools can't access on the public internet.
items.author: Marina Temkin

items.title: Clipto uses AI to search terabytes of video and is now valued at $250M
items.summary: The three-year-old startup says it reached $15 million in ARR and profitability before raising its latest $15 million round.
items.author: Kate Park

items.title: Nvidia’s $3.5B MediaTek bet reveals its plan for tackling Big Tech’s AI chip buildout
items.summary: Nvidia invests $3.5 billion into Taiwanese chipmaker MediaTek. The deal shows how Nvidia plans to stay essential to AI infrastructure as Big Tech begins to build its own AI chips.
items.author: Rebecca Bellan

items.title: Meeting note-taker Circleback adds a free tier to attract more customers
items.summary: Circleback is also introducing new pricing plans starting from $14 per month.
items.author: Ivan Mehta
